exclusions: Chapter 7 adversary/NPC stat blocks were not added because the character sheet has no adversary database.
Merchant-trade procedures and general setting history were not added as character options.
Full random Lifepath event tables were not reproduced; named Traits, host rules, homelands and career tables relevant to player creation were incorporated.
Where the supplement referenced core items/talents rather than defining them, only directly needed missing entries were cross-checked against the Core/Collector's Edition.
normalisations: Source typos in skill names were normalised to the sheet's canonical skill names (e.g. Ballisctis → Ballistics, Resitance → Resistance, Atheletics → Athletics).
Source § combat profiles are retained in rules notes rather than silently converted to the sheet's simplified d6 weapon system.
Source armour profiles are retained in notes while the sheet continues to use its Light 5 / Medium 10 / Heavy 15 Armour convention.
Ariadna nations and Dog-Blooded/Antipode heritage groupings are represented as Faction subchoices for UI compatibility, not as a claim that they are separate political factions.
